name: feature.computer-use.nodes
description: Computer-use browser-agent nodes (ADR 0418 / ADR 0894) over ctx.features['computer-use']: `task` starts/resumes a provider-hosted browser session and runs the risk-tiered loop until completion or a commit-class action halts it awaiting approval; `decide` then asks the person who started the session about that one action (it raises the approval itself — nothing wired into it can approve) and resumes or ends the session; `status` reads the session. Fail-closed origin allowlist (private and internal addresses refused), per-tenant daily session budget, wall-clock ceiling, recorded trajectories (replay never re-drives a browser). role:action.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Computer Use: Run Task
nodes.description: Starts (or resumes — submit-once on identical inputs from the same person) a browser-agent session and advances the risk-tiered loop: observe/interact actions auto-approve and record; a commit-class action (submit/download/new-origin) halts with state `awaiting_approval` for the `decide` node; credential entry is refused. Needs a person behind the run and run access (runs:create) in the org. Inputs: { orgId, task, startUrl, allowedOrigins[] (https public origins, fail-closed) }. Output: { session: { sessionId, status, steps, pendingAction?, resultSummary?, error? } }.

nodes.label: Computer Use: Decide Pending Action
nodes.description: Asks the person who started the session to approve or reject its pending commit-class action, by raising an approval for exactly that action (only that person may answer it), then resumes (approve) or ends the session (reject); repeats for each later commit. Nothing wired into this node can approve: an approval counts only as the recorded answer to the approval this node raised. Inputs: { sessionId } or { session } from a task node. Output: { session }.

nodes.label: Computer Use: Session Status
nodes.description: Reads a session's recorded state (status, step count, pending action, result). Inputs: { sessionId }. Output: { session | null }. Readable by members of the session's org.
